newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P upgrades Maybank to A-plus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P upgrades Maybank to A-plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it upgraded the long-term counterparty rating of Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) to A-plus from A.
S&P said Maybank's outlook was stable.
"The upgrade is based on the bank's continued strong and competitive position in its core home market, enhanced financial performance, and improved asset quality," S&P said.
"Also reflected in the upgrade is the continued maturing of the Malaysian regulatory system, and deepening of the economy."
S&P said earnings and growth prospects for Maybank were favourable, "tempered by sensitivities associated with operating in emerging markets".
"Profitability and other financial measures should remain at current levels," S&P said.
"Standard and Poor's will continue to monitor Maybank's performance for any possible deterioration in financial profile."
